note: Redwood County parcels are published only through the Schneider Beacon viewer, which returns a Cloudflare challenge (403) to automated access and exposes no public ArcGIS REST endpoint. The county points parcel data requests to a GIS data request form and a fee schedule. Redwood County is absent from the state opt-in open parcel service: queries at the county's point return no features and co_name has no Redwood match.
